title: Loi sur l'aide aux personnes et aux familles (Individual and Family Assistance Act)
verified_how: NOT verified against the register: www.legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca refused every request with HTTP 403 from Amazon CloudFront ('Request blocked'), so neither the register's own title page nor its 'a jour au' date could be read. The French title and RLRQ chapter number recorded here are corroborated only by LegisQuebec page titles and PDF headings that appeared in web-search results (e.g. 'chapitre A-13.1.1 LOI SUR L'AIDE AUX PERSONNES ET AUX FAMILLES'), which is not a substitute for the register.
notes: Quebec's social-assistance statute (aide sociale, solidarite sociale, Programme de revenu de base). Employment Insurance is federal, but note that Quebec runs its own parental insurance plan under the Loi sur l'assurance parentale, RLRQ c. A-29.011.
